lastCompletedStory.title: Add effort config read/write plumbing (no UI)

nextStoryContext: US-001 landed the config plumbing only (no wizard UI step, no frontmatter writer): `LlmPhase` (= Exclude<Phase, 'ship'>) and `EFFORT_DEFAULTS`/`readPhaseEffort` live in src/config/models.ts, mirroring readPhaseModel's try/catch defaults exactly (missing file/section/key/malformed TOML/non-string all fall back to EFFORT_DEFAULTS). ConfigChoices (src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx) gained an OPTIONAL `efforts?: Record<LlmPhase, string>` field -- the wizard itself does NOT yet collect it (no new WizardStep, no Select UI); a later UI story will need to add an effort-picking step per LLM phase and wire it into the onDone() choices object (currently only `models`/`backend` are always populated there, see ConfigScreen.tsx ~line 304). mergeConfigChoices (src/commands/config.ts) writes an [efforts] section via mergeIntoConfig ONLY when choices.efforts is defined, mirroring the [models] write, and only ever contains the 5 LLM-phase keys (never 'ship') since the type forbids it. Ship remains model-only (ADR-0009: deterministic/zero-LLM, no effort concept) -- do not add ship to EFFORT_DEFAULTS, LlmPhase, or any efforts record. A later frontmatter story will presumably need to plumb effort into the .claude/ runtime files the same way rewriteFrontmatterModels does for model (src/commands/config.ts ~line 134), but that is out of scope here and not implemented.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.TOML.parse(input: string): object confirmed; readPhaseEffort's try/catch around loadConfig (which wraps Bun.TOML.parse) correctly treats any parse throw as a fallback-to-default path, matching readPhaseModel's existing pattern.
